findings.root_cause: Query qualification is treated as timeless while current verified-reader publication can replace it unchecked; a now-null value is silently replaced with stale query date. Raw-byte SHA verification does not bind mutable metadata/as-of qualification.
findings.minimal_reproduction: Query qualified 2026-07-22 at as-of 2026-09-30; verified reader of same valid bytes reports 2027-01-01, not-a-date, or None. All three actual FF flows returned reused and as_of_cutoff_verified=true; None reused the stale date.
findings.expected: Current unknown/invalid/post-as-of or changed qualification must return honest gap/lookup-changed, zero provider calls, and must never claim historical eligibility or replace unknown by stale date.
findings.implementation_boundary: Reuse source-owner qualification/verified metadata contract; no new permission chain or extra provider retry. A strict changed-metadata refusal using existing transport date primitive is safe pending a current owner-qualified read receipt.
validation: Known eligible stable date stays reusable
Future/invalid/unknown final date never yields as_of_cutoff_verified=true
All changed/invalid paths zero ET calls and preserve raw/SHA

findings.root_cause: A new FF identity normalizer strips leading zeroes for all markets, repeating identity interpretation already owned by CWP market-qualified security_code normalization.
findings.minimal_reproduction: US request MSFT; query selects MSFT; verified current manifest says market US and security_id 0MSFT with valid matching bytes. Actual FF returns reused/as_of_cutoff_verified=true because both normalize to msft.
findings.expected: Distinct US ticker strings remain distinct; legitimate numeric HK/CN padding is handled by the market-qualified source owner. Missing/unknown source market must not borrow request market as identity proof.
findings.implementation_boundary: Consume existing source-owner canonical identity projection alongside immutable observed manifest; do not add a second per-market regex implementation or new lookup/permission chain. Legacy receipt may safely use exact identity or return honest unresolved gap.
validation: US MSFT versus 0MSFT rejected; dotted/dashed securities preserved
HK/CN numeric formatting equivalent only when source market is actually established
Unknown market cannot gain identity by request; correct same-source reuse still zero-download
